name: Condottieri Guards
headerMeta: Silver era · Melee Infantry (shields) · 160 leadership · T3 mastery

origin.text: Honor Tree unit today; originally launched in 2020 as a Season 3 seasonal unit with its own unlock line.
unlock: 2020 seasonal unlock line: six challenges per stage across three stages - likely superseded by the current Honor Tree path

pitch: A cost-effective, forgiving shielded melee line built to charge into Shock Attack for burst damage, at its best as a flanking cleanup unit rather than a frontline vanguard. Its low cost makes it a fine trade to buy time or map control, but an unsupported charge into a braced pike line or tight shield wall gets it wiped.

doctrines.name: Stamina Doctrine V
doctrines.effect: -24% charge CD, +1 charge target. Mandatory per Amya.

doctrines.name: Damage-reduction doctrine
doctrines.effect: Another -5% DMG taken doctrine, alt for LDS or fills the free slot. Filler.
doctrines.note: −5% DMG taken, alternative for LDS or free slot

veterancy.label: Top line
veterancy.body: Boosts the primary damage tool (Shock Attack/Shock Shieldbash): +5% movement, +8% critical, +30% skill damage, +3s duration, −3s cooldown — cuts effective downtime from 18s to 9s. {2}

battleRole.positioning: Exploit the unit's speed for lateral repositioning and flanking — reposition unseen, hit targets from the rear or sides for bonus flank damage; even without a clean flank route, walking the sides of a fight instead of piling onto the center usually nets bonus damage. {2} Spread into loose formation vs tight shield walls (e.g. Imperial Spears) — route the charge around the line, envelop from the side, and stagger-lock with Shock Attack. {2} Map-specific flank timing matters — e.g. on Valley Fortress, stage near a captured point and scout for the stall between pushes; flanking while the enemy is actively pushing a point is poor team play. {2}
battleRole.tips: Alternative engagement order: move/flank first, press Shock Attack, then charge into melee once in position — lets you hit backline/high-value targets from behind. {2} Cost-effective unit: sacrificing Condottieri Guards to secure map control or an objective trade is often a net win given the low leadership cost — one clip nets 175 leadership spent for a 700-leadership kill. {2} Recommended attack-roster farm pick in its era/tier bracket, alongside Halberdiers and Prefecture Guards — flagged likely-stale, pre-dates the current patch. {3}

cards.name: Fortebraccio Pikemen
cards.why: one of the game's strongest braces — an unsupported charge gets Condottieri wiped almost instantly; even minor melee-hero CC flips the fight once the pike formation breaks.

cards.name: Imperial Spears
cards.why: tight shield-wall formation — head-on charge with no CC yields little; requires flank spread-and-envelop instead.

cards.name: Pavese Crossbowmen
cards.why: high-value flank target — a surprise charge on an unprotected backline crossbow unit is a clean net win even on a losing trade.

controls.notes: Primary combo: charge launches the Shock Shieldbash after it; {1} Shock Attack (press 2) is your main DPS spell — usually let the charge's attack animation play out, then press 2. {1} Alternative: X-move/Flank, press 2, then charge once in melee. {1}
